targets.query:
SELECT sum(traffic) AS top_traffic
FROM (
  SELECT item, traffic FROM (
    SELECT multiIf(
          ${by:singlequote} = 'src', ipToStr(src_addr, etype),
          ${by:singlequote} = 'dst', ipToStr(dst_addr, etype),
          ${by:singlequote} = 'pair', concat(ipToStr(src_addr, etype), ' → ', ipToStr(dst_addr, etype)),
          ${by:singlequote} = 'service', concat(
          ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), toString(proto)),
          '/',
          multiIf(
            nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)), '') != '', dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)),
            nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(src_port)), '') != '', dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(src_port)),
            dst_port > 0 AND dst_port < 1024, concat('port-', toString(dst_port)),
            src_port > 0 AND src_port < 1024, concat('port-', toString(src_port)),
            concat('port-', toString(if(dst_port > 0, dst_port, src_port))))),
          ${by:singlequote} = 'proto', multiIf(proto = 6, 'TCP', proto = 17, 'UDP', proto = 1, 'ICMP', proto = 58, 'ICMPv6', proto = 47, 'GRE',
          ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), concat('Other(', toString(proto), ')'))),
          ${by:singlequote} = 'exporter', ipToStr(sampler_address, etype),
          ipToStr(src_addr, etype)) AS item, sum(bytes_norm) AS traffic, sum(packets_norm) AS packets, count() AS flows,
           any(concat(multiIf(
          ${by:singlequote} = 'src', concat('/d/flow-ip-lookup?var-role=any&var-ip=', encodeURLComponent(ipToStr(src_addr, etype))),
          ${by:singlequote} = 'dst', concat('/d/flow-ip-lookup?var-role=any&var-ip=', encodeURLComponent(ipToStr(dst_addr, etype))),
          ${by:singlequote} = 'pair', concat('/d/flow-sankey?var-dimension=src_port&var-src_net=', encodeURLComponent(concat(ipToStr(src_addr, etype), if(etype = 2048, '/32', '/128'))),
                                             '&var-dst_net=', encodeURLComponent(concat(ipToStr(dst_addr, etype), if(etype = 2048, '/32', '/128')))),
          ${by:singlequote} = 'exporter', concat('/d/flow-traffic-overview?var-exporter=', encodeURLComponent(ipToStr(sampler_address, etype))),
          '#'),
        if(${by:singlequote} IN ('src', 'dst', 'pair', 'exporter'), concat('&from=', toString($from * 1000), '&to=', toString($to * 1000)), ''))) AS link_url
    FROM $table
    WHERE $timeFilter
      AND (
        ${scope:singlequote} = 'all'
        OR (etype = 2048 AND ${scope:singlequote} = 'ew' AND isRfc1918OrCgnat(src_addr) AND isRfc1918OrCgnat(dst_addr))
        OR (etype = 2048 AND ${scope:singlequote} = 'ns' AND isRfc1918OrCgnat(src_addr) != isRfc1918OrCgnat(dst_addr))
      )
      AND (${exporter:singlequote} = 'All' OR ipToStr(sampler_address, etype) = ${exporter:singlequote})
      AND (${src_net:singlequote} = '' OR (throwIf(NOT arrayAll(t -> (isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', t)[1]) AND toUInt16OrDefault(splitByChar('/', t)[2], 999) <= 32) OR (isIPv6String(splitByChar('/', t)[1]) AND toUInt16OrDefault(splitByChar('/', t)[2], 999) <= 128), arrayMap(t -> if(position(t, '/') = 0, concat(t, if(position(t, ':') > 0, '/128', '/32')), t), arrayFilter(t -> t != '', splitByChar(',', replaceAll(${src_net:singlequote}, ' ', ''))))), concat('Invalid CIDR in the filter: ', ${src_net:singlequote}, ' - use e.g. 10.1.0.0/16 or 10.1.2.3, comma separated for several')) = 0
          AND arrayExists(c -> isIPAddressInRange(ipToStr(src_addr, etype), c), arrayMap(t -> if(position(t, '/') = 0, concat(t, if(position(t, ':') > 0, '/128', '/32')), t), arrayFilter(t -> t != '', splitByChar(',', replaceAll(${src_net:singlequote}, ' ', '')))))))
      AND (${dst_net:singlequote} = '' OR (throwIf(NOT arrayAll(t -> (isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', t)[1]) AND toUInt16OrDefault(splitByChar('/', t)[2], 999) <= 32) OR (isIPv6String(splitByChar('/', t)[1]) AND toUInt16OrDefault(splitByChar('/', t)[2], 999) <= 128), arrayMap(t -> if(position(t, '/') = 0, concat(t, if(position(t, ':') > 0, '/128', '/32')), t), arrayFilter(t -> t != '', splitByChar(',', replaceAll(${dst_net:singlequote}, ' ', ''))))), concat('Invalid CIDR in the filter: ', ${dst_net:singlequote}, ' - use e.g. 10.1.0.0/16 or 10.1.2.3, comma separated for several')) = 0
          AND arrayExists(c -> isIPAddressInRange(ipToStr(dst_addr, etype), c), arrayMap(t -> if(position(t, '/') = 0, concat(t, if(position(t, ':') > 0, '/128', '/32')), t), arrayFilter(t -> t != '', splitByChar(',', replaceAll(${dst_net:singlequote}, ' ', '')))))))
    GROUP BY item
  ) ORDER BY traffic DESC LIMIT greatest(toUInt64OrDefault(${topn:singlequote}, toUInt64(8)), 1)
)

targets.query:
SELECT round(100 * sumIf(traffic, rn <= greatest(toUInt64OrDefault(${topn:singlequote}, toUInt64(8)), 1)) / greatest(sum(traffic), 1), 1) AS share
FROM (
  SELECT traffic, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY traffic DESC) AS rn FROM (
    SELECT multiIf(
      ${by:singlequote} = 'src', ipToStr(src_addr, etype),
      ${by:singlequote} = 'dst', ipToStr(dst_addr, etype),
      ${by:singlequote} = 'pair', concat(ipToStr(src_addr, etype), ' → ', ipToStr(dst_addr, etype)),
      ${by:singlequote} = 'service', concat(
      ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), toString(proto)),
      '/',
      multiIf(
        nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)), '') != '', dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)),
        nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(src_port)), '') != '', dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(src_port)),
        dst_port > 0 AND dst_port < 1024, concat('port-', toString(dst_port)),
        src_port > 0 AND src_port < 1024, concat('port-', toString(src_port)),
        concat('port-', toString(if(dst_port > 0, dst_port, src_port))))),
      ${by:singlequote} = 'proto', multiIf(proto = 6, 'TCP', proto = 17, 'UDP', proto = 1, 'ICMP', proto = 58, 'ICMPv6', proto = 47, 'GRE',
      ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), concat('Other(', toString(proto), ')'))),
      ${by:singlequote} = 'exporter', ipToStr(sampler_address, etype),
      ipToStr(src_addr, etype)) AS item, sum(bytes_norm) AS traffic
    FROM $table
    WHERE $timeFilter
      AND (
        ${scope:singlequote} = 'all'
        OR (etype = 2048 AND ${scope:singlequote} = 'ew' AND isRfc1918OrCgnat(src_addr) AND isRfc1918OrCgnat(dst_addr))
        OR (etype = 2048 AND ${scope:singlequote} = 'ns' AND isRfc1918OrCgnat(src_addr) != isRfc1918OrCgnat(dst_addr))
      )
      AND (${exporter:singlequote} = 'All' OR ipToStr(sampler_address, etype) = ${exporter:singlequote})
      AND (${src_net:singlequote} = '' OR (throwIf(NOT arrayAll(t -> (isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', t)[1]) AND toUInt16OrDefault(splitByChar('/', t)[2], 999) <= 32) OR (isIPv6String(splitByChar('/', t)[1]) AND toUInt16OrDefault(splitByChar('/', t)[2], 999) <= 128), arrayMap(t -> if(position(t, '/') = 0, concat(t, if(position(t, ':') > 0, '/128', '/32')), t), arrayFilter(t -> t != '', splitByChar(',', replaceAll(${src_net:singlequote}, ' ', ''))))), concat('Invalid CIDR in the filter: ', ${src_net:singlequote}, ' - use e.g. 10.1.0.0/16 or 10.1.2.3, comma separated for several')) = 0
          AND arrayExists(c -> isIPAddressInRange(ipToStr(src_addr, etype), c), arrayMap(t -> if(position(t, '/') = 0, concat(t, if(position(t, ':') > 0, '/128', '/32')), t), arrayFilter(t -> t != '', splitByChar(',', replaceAll(${src_net:singlequote}, ' ', '')))))))
      AND (${dst_net:singlequote} = '' OR (throwIf(NOT arrayAll(t -> (isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', t)[1]) AND toUInt16OrDefault(splitByChar('/', t)[2], 999) <= 32) OR (isIPv6String(splitByChar('/', t)[1]) AND toUInt16OrDefault(splitByChar('/', t)[2], 999) <= 128), arrayMap(t -> if(position(t, '/') = 0, concat(t, if(position(t, ':') > 0, '/128', '/32')), t), arrayFilter(t -> t != '', splitByChar(',', replaceAll(${dst_net:singlequote}, ' ', ''))))), concat('Invalid CIDR in the filter: ', ${dst_net:singlequote}, ' - use e.g. 10.1.0.0/16 or 10.1.2.3, comma separated for several')) = 0
          AND arrayExists(c -> isIPAddressInRange(ipToStr(dst_addr, etype), c), arrayMap(t -> if(position(t, '/') = 0, concat(t, if(position(t, ':') > 0, '/128', '/32')), t), arrayFilter(t -> t != '', splitByChar(',', replaceAll(${dst_net:singlequote}, ' ', '')))))))
    GROUP BY item
  )
)

panels.title: Rate of the Top N
panels.description: Bits per second over time for the same Top N items.

targets.query:
SELECT t, item, rate
FROM (
  SELECT t, item, rate, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY tot DESC) AS rk
  FROM (
    SELECT t, item, rate, sum(rate) OVER (PARTITION BY item) AS tot
    FROM (
      SELECT $timeSeries AS t, multiIf(
      ${by:singlequote} = 'src', ipToStr(src_addr, etype),
      ${by:singlequote} = 'dst', ipToStr(dst_addr, etype),
      ${by:singlequote} = 'pair', concat(ipToStr(src_addr, etype), ' → ', ipToStr(dst_addr, etype)),
      ${by:singlequote} = 'service', concat(
      ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), toString(proto)),
      '/',
      multiIf(
        nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)), '') != '', dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)),
        nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(src_port)), '') != '', dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(src_port)),
        dst_port > 0 AND dst_port < 1024, concat('port-', toString(dst_port)),
        src_port > 0 AND src_port < 1024, concat('port-', toString(src_port)),
        concat('port-', toString(if(dst_port > 0, dst_port, src_port))))),
      ${by:singlequote} = 'proto', multiIf(proto = 6, 'TCP', proto = 17, 'UDP', proto = 1, 'ICMP', proto = 58, 'ICMPv6', proto = 47, 'GRE',
      ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), concat('Other(', toString(proto), ')'))),
      ${by:singlequote} = 'exporter', ipToStr(sampler_address, etype),
      ipToStr(src_addr, etype)) AS item, sum(bytes_norm) * 8 / $interval AS rate
      FROM $table
      WHERE $timeFilter
        AND (
          ${scope:singlequote} = 'all'
          OR (etype = 2048 AND ${scope:singlequote} = 'ew' AND isRfc1918OrCgnat(src_addr) AND isRfc1918OrCgnat(dst_addr))
          OR (etype = 2048 AND ${scope:singlequote} = 'ns' AND isRfc1918OrCgnat(src_addr) != isRfc1918OrCgnat(dst_addr))
        )
        AND (${exporter:singlequote} = 'All' OR ipToStr(sampler_address, etype) = ${exporter:singlequote})
        AND (${src_net:singlequote} = '' OR (throwIf(NOT arrayAll(t -> (isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', t)[1]) AND toUInt16OrDefault(splitByChar('/', t)[2], 999) <= 32) OR (isIPv6String(splitByChar('/', t)[1]) AND toUInt16OrDefault(splitByChar('/', t)[2], 999) <= 128), arrayMap(t -> if(position(t, '/') = 0, concat(t, if(position(t, ':') > 0, '/128', '/32')), t), arrayFilter(t -> t != '', splitByChar(',', replaceAll(${src_net:singlequote}, ' ', ''))))), concat('Invalid CIDR in the filter: ', ${src_net:singlequote}, ' - use e.g. 10.1.0.0/16 or 10.1.2.3, comma separated for several')) = 0
            AND arrayExists(c -> isIPAddressInRange(ipToStr(src_addr, etype), c), arrayMap(t -> if(position(t, '/') = 0, concat(t, if(position(t, ':') > 0, '/128', '/32')), t), arrayFilter(t -> t != '', splitByChar(',', replaceAll(${src_net:singlequote}, ' ', '')))))))
        AND (${dst_net:singlequote} = '' OR (throwIf(NOT arrayAll(t -> (isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', t)[1]) AND toUInt16OrDefault(splitByChar('/', t)[2], 999) <= 32) OR (isIPv6String(splitByChar('/', t)[1]) AND toUInt16OrDefault(splitByChar('/', t)[2], 999) <= 128), arrayMap(t -> if(position(t, '/') = 0, concat(t, if(position(t, ':') > 0, '/128', '/32')), t), arrayFilter(t -> t != '', splitByChar(',', replaceAll(${dst_net:singlequote}, ' ', ''))))), concat('Invalid CIDR in the filter: ', ${dst_net:singlequote}, ' - use e.g. 10.1.0.0/16 or 10.1.2.3, comma separated for several')) = 0
            AND arrayExists(c -> isIPAddressInRange(ipToStr(dst_addr, etype), c), arrayMap(t -> if(position(t, '/') = 0, concat(t, if(position(t, ':') > 0, '/128', '/32')), t), arrayFilter(t -> t != '', splitByChar(',', replaceAll(${dst_net:singlequote}, ' ', '')))))))
      GROUP BY t, item
    )
  )
)
WHERE rk <= greatest(toUInt64OrDefault(${topn:singlequote}, toUInt64(8)), 1)
ORDER BY t

panels.title: Top N details
panels.description: Same ranking with packets, flow records, share of total and average bytes per flow. Click an item: IP rankings open IP Lookup, conversations open the Sankey (ports) for that pair, exporters open Traffic Overview; service / protocol rows have no link.

targets.query:
SELECT item, traffic, packets, flows, link_url,
       round(100 * traffic / greatest(sum(traffic) OVER (), 1), 2) AS share_pct,
       round(traffic / greatest(flows, 1)) AS avg_flow
FROM (
  SELECT multiIf(
        ${by:singlequote} = 'src', ipToStr(src_addr, etype),
        ${by:singlequote} = 'dst', ipToStr(dst_addr, etype),
        ${by:singlequote} = 'pair', concat(ipToStr(src_addr, etype), ' → ', ipToStr(dst_addr, etype)),
        ${by:singlequote} = 'service', concat(
        ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), toString(proto)),
        '/',
        multiIf(
          nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)), '') != '', dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)),
          nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(src_port)), '') != '', dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(src_port)),
          dst_port > 0 AND dst_port < 1024, concat('port-', toString(dst_port)),
          src_port > 0 AND src_port < 1024, concat('port-', toString(src_port)),
          concat('port-', toString(if(dst_port > 0, dst_port, src_port))))),
        ${by:singlequote} = 'proto', multiIf(proto = 6, 'TCP', proto = 17, 'UDP', proto = 1, 'ICMP', proto = 58, 'ICMPv6', proto = 47, 'GRE',
        ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), concat('Other(', toString(proto), ')'))),
        ${by:singlequote} = 'exporter', ipToStr(sampler_address, etype),
        ipToStr(src_addr, etype)) AS item, sum(bytes_norm) AS traffic, sum(packets_norm) AS packets, count() AS flows,
         any(concat(multiIf(
        ${by:singlequote} = 'src', concat('/d/flow-ip-lookup?var-role=any&var-ip=', encodeURLComponent(ipToStr(src_addr, etype))),
        ${by:singlequote} = 'dst', concat('/d/flow-ip-lookup?var-role=any&var-ip=', encodeURLComponent(ipToStr(dst_addr, etype))),
        ${by:singlequote} = 'pair', concat('/d/flow-sankey?var-dimension=src_port&var-src_net=', encodeURLComponent(concat(ipToStr(src_addr, etype), if(etype = 2048, '/32', '/128'))),
                                           '&var-dst_net=', encodeURLComponent(concat(ipToStr(dst_addr, etype), if(etype = 2048, '/32', '/128')))),
        ${by:singlequote} = 'exporter', concat('/d/flow-traffic-overview?var-exporter=', encodeURLComponent(ipToStr(sampler_address, etype))),
        '#'),
      if(${by:singlequote} IN ('src', 'dst', 'pair', 'exporter'), concat('&from=', toString($from * 1000), '&to=', toString($to * 1000)), ''))) AS link_url
  FROM $table
  WHERE $timeFilter
    AND (
      ${scope:singlequote} = 'all'
      OR (etype = 2048 AND ${scope:singlequote} = 'ew' AND isRfc1918OrCgnat(src_addr) AND isRfc1918OrCgnat(dst_addr))
      OR (etype = 2048 AND ${scope:singlequote} = 'ns' AND isRfc1918OrCgnat(src_addr) != isRfc1918OrCgnat(dst_addr))
    )
    AND (${exporter:singlequote} = 'All' OR ipToStr(sampler_address, etype) = ${exporter:singlequote})
    AND (${src_net:singlequote} = '' OR (throwIf(NOT arrayAll(t -> (isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', t)[1]) AND toUInt16OrDefault(splitByChar('/', t)[2], 999) <= 32) OR (isIPv6String(splitByChar('/', t)[1]) AND toUInt16OrDefault(splitByChar('/', t)[2], 999) <= 128), arrayMap(t -> if(position(t, '/') = 0, concat(t, if(position(t, ':') > 0, '/128', '/32')), t), arrayFilter(t -> t != '', splitByChar(',', replaceAll(${src_net:singlequote}, ' ', ''))))), concat('Invalid CIDR in the filter: ', ${src_net:singlequote}, ' - use e.g. 10.1.0.0/16 or 10.1.2.3, comma separated for several')) = 0
        AND arrayExists(c -> isIPAddressInRange(ipToStr(src_addr, etype), c), arrayMap(t -> if(position(t, '/') = 0, concat(t, if(position(t, ':') > 0, '/128', '/32')), t), arrayFilter(t -> t != '', splitByChar(',', replaceAll(${src_net:singlequote}, ' ', '')))))))
    AND (${dst_net:singlequote} = '' OR (throwIf(NOT arrayAll(t -> (isIPv4String(splitByChar('/', t)[1]) AND toUInt16OrDefault(splitByChar('/', t)[2], 999) <= 32) OR (isIPv6String(splitByChar('/', t)[1]) AND toUInt16OrDefault(splitByChar('/', t)[2], 999) <= 128), arrayMap(t -> if(position(t, '/') = 0, concat(t, if(position(t, ':') > 0, '/128', '/32')), t), arrayFilter(t -> t != '', splitByChar(',', replaceAll(${dst_net:singlequote}, ' ', ''))))), concat('Invalid CIDR in the filter: ', ${dst_net:singlequote}, ' - use e.g. 10.1.0.0/16 or 10.1.2.3, comma separated for several')) = 0
        AND arrayExists(c -> isIPAddressInRange(ipToStr(dst_addr, etype), c), arrayMap(t -> if(position(t, '/') = 0, concat(t, if(position(t, ':') > 0, '/128', '/32')), t), arrayFilter(t -> t != '', splitByChar(',', replaceAll(${dst_net:singlequote}, ' ', '')))))))
  GROUP BY item
)
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT greatest(toUInt64OrDefault(${topn:singlequote}, toUInt64(8)), 1)
